judgments.rationale: The proposed edit incorporates substantive rules from subsection (1) and subsection (5) into the summary of claim C0002. However, C0002 specifically governs subsection (2) regarding additional fees for petit jurors. The other provisions are already independently represented by other claims (such as C0000, C0001, and C0005). Expanding C0002 to bundle separate statutory rules does not resolve an existing defect.

The proposed edit alters the modal force and legal effect of subsection (2) by asserting that the juror 'must be paid, without trial-judge discretion', directly contradicting the source text in F002, which provides that the fee 'may be paid, in the discretion of the trial judge'.

source_spans.quote: (1) A juror shall be paid an attendance fee of $50 per day for actual attendance at the place of trial or hearing. A juror shall also be paid the attendance fee for the time necessarily occupied in going to and returning from such place at the beginning and end of such service or at any time during such service.

(2) A petit juror required to attend more than ten days in hearing one case may be paid, in the discretion of the trial judge, an additional fee, not exceeding $10 more than the attendance fee, for each day in excess of ten days on which he is required to hear such case.
(5) Certification of additional attendance fees may be ordered by the judge to be made effective commencing on the first day of extended service, without reference to the date of such certification.
